verdict.rationale: Docs show scalable ingestion mechanics (auto-extraction from raw content, customId-based incremental updates, connectors with real-time webhook sync, multi-modal extractors, list/get/update/delete on ingested documents) that imply background processing, but there is no explicit async/batch ingestion endpoint or a documented status-check API for background memory operations. missing for 10: explicit batch ingestion endpoint, documented job/status API for tracking async extraction progress, evidence of scale/throughput guarantees.
